character.intro: Say goodbye to the warm cradle and confront the painful awakening—she has traversed infinite loops to enter the real world with the full might of the matrix.

affix.name: Ignition
affix.description: The frame's condensed nitrogen has been replaced with a newly created chemical material with an optimized ignition process, making it easier to set the target on fire and deal damage to it over time through attacks.

specialties.name: Burst
specialties.description: Deals massive DMG in a short time.

specialties.name: Ignition
specialties.description: Launches the enemy into the Combustible status and Ignites them.

descriptions.title: Shadow Slash: <color=#0d70bc>Tap Red Orb</color>
descriptions.description: Hurls the gunsword toward the target, dealing Dark DMG.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>46.32%</color>/<color=#D91414>92.65%</color> Dark DMG based on the number of orbs pinged.

descriptions.title: Spin Cleave: <color=#0d70bc>At least 1 Cluster Orb + During Shadow Slash + Tap Red Orb</color>
descriptions.description: Spins around and swings the gunsword at the target, dealing Dark DMG.\n- For every Cluster Orb pinged, casts this skill again to deal <color=#D91414>51.47%</color> Dark DMG.

descriptions.title: Kinetic Load: <color=#0d70bc>Press and hold Red Orb to charge + Absurdum Points fully charged</color>
descriptions.description: Enters <color=#D91414>Charge Stance</color>, then unleashes a sword strike upon release, dealing Dark DMG.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>257.35%</color>/<color=#D91414>514.71%</color>/<color=#D91414>772.06%</color>/<color=#D91414>1029.41%</color> Dark DMG and recovers <color=#D91414>2/3/4/5</color> Signature Energy after pinging <color=#D91414>0/1/2/3</color> orbs.

descriptions.title: Kindled Blaze: <color=#0d70bc>Press and hold Red Orb to charge + Absurdum Points partially charged</color>
descriptions.description: Enters <color=#D91414>Charge Stance</color>, then unleashes a sword strike upon release, dealing Ignition DMG and applying Combustible Charges.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>257.35%</color>/<color=#D91414>514.71%</color>/<color=#D91414>772.06%</color>/<color=#D91414>1029.41%</color> Ignition DMG, applies <color=#D91414>1250</color> Combustible Charges, and restores <color=#D91414>2/3/4/5</color> Signature Energy after pinging <color=#D91414>0/1/2/3</color> orbs. When <color=#D91414>Absurdum Points</color> are not fully charged, Jetavie continuously gains <color=#D91414>Super Armor</color>.

descriptions.title: Flare Shot: <color=#0d70bc>Tap Yellow Orb</color>
descriptions.description: Leaps backward to spray a barrage of bullets, dealing Dark DMG.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>123.53%</color>/<color=#D91414>247.06%</color> Dark DMG based on the number of orbs pinged.

descriptions.title: Sniper's Perch: <color=#0d70bc>Press and hold Yellow Orb to charge</color>
descriptions.description: Leaps backward to enter <color=#D91414>Charge Stance</color>, then fires a shot upon release, dealing Dark DMG.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>226.47%</color>/<color=#D91414>452.94%</color>/<color=#D91414>555.88%</color>/<color=#D91414>658.82%</color> Dark DMG and recovers <color=#D91414>2/3/4/5</color> Signature Energy after pinging <color=#D91414>0/1/2/3</color> orbs.

descriptions.title: Shaded Radiance: <color=#0d70bc>Tap Blue Orb</color>
descriptions.description: Flicks the gunsword upward, firing at the target and dealing Dark DMG.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>46.32%</color>/<color=#D91414>92.65%</color> Dark DMG based on the number of orbs pinged.

descriptions.title: Sundered Pith: <color=#0d70bc>Press and hold Blue Orb to charge</color>
descriptions.description: Enters <color=#D91414>Charge Stance</color> while wielding the gunsword to fire continuously, then steps back upon release to deal Dark DMG.\n- Each burst of shots deals <color=#D91414>30.88%</color> Dark DMG.\n- Stepping back deals <color=#D91414>102.94%</color>/<color=#D91414>205.88%</color>/<color=#D91414>308.82%</color>/<color=#D91414>411.76%</color> Dark DMG and recovers <color=#D91414>2/3/4/5</color> Signature Energy after pinging <color=#D91414>0/1/2/3</color> orbs.

descriptions.title: Iteration: <color=#0d70bc>Tap Basic Attack</color>
descriptions.description: Fires at the target while performing combat maneuvers, dealing Dark DMG.\n- Basic Attack deals a total of <color=#D91414>350%</color> Dark DMG.

descriptions.title: Continuation: <color=#0d70bc>Press and hold Basic Attack to charge</color>
descriptions.description: Enters <color=#D91414>Charge Stance</color> while wielding the gunsword to fire continuously at the target, dealing Dark DMG.\n- Each burst of shots deals <color=#D91414>30.88%</color> Dark DMG.

descriptions.title: Constant Current: <color=#0d70bc>100 Signature Energy + Tap Signature</color>
descriptions.description: Jetavie enters the <color=#D91414>Panoptic Segmentation</color> Mode, dealing Dark DMG to nearby targets in a large area and summoning a great sword to assist in the attack.\n- <color=#D91414>Constant Current</color> deals <color=#D91414>1338.24%</color> Dark DMG in total.

descriptions.title: Tectonic Revolt: <color=#0d70bc>In Panoptic Segmentation + 100 Signature Energy + Tap Signature</color>
descriptions.description: Jetavie leaps into the air and plunges down to strike the target on the ground, dealing damage before exiting the <color=#D91414>Panoptic Segmentation</color> Mode.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>3088.24%</color> Dark DMG in total.\n- If Jetavie has <color=#D91414>Coreflame Mark</color>, casts <color=#D91414>Tectonic Revolt: Burn</color> instead, dealing <color=#D91414>2264.71%</color> Ignition DMG, removing the target's Ignition status, and inflicting additional Ignition DMG equal to <color=#D91414>Ignition stacks x<color=#D91414>102.94%</color></color>.

descriptions.title: QTE: <color=#0d70bc>Tap QTE</color>
descriptions.description: Flicks the gunsword upward, firing at the target and dealing Dark DMG.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>679.41%</color> Dark DMG in total.

descriptions.title: Cluster Analysis
descriptions.description: Signal Orbs gained are converted into <color=#D91414>Cluster Orbs</color>. When not in the <color=#D91414>Panoptic Segmentation</color> Mode, Jetavie can only cast Yellow or Blue Orb Skills. After she enters <color=#D91414>Panoptic Segmentation</color>, Red Orb Skills will be available. When entering <color=#D91414>Charge Stance</color> by pinging Signal Orbs, continuously restores Signature Energy, up to <color=#D91414>40</color>. Pinging <color=#D91414>Cluster Orbs</color> enhances the corresponding Charged Skill, up to <color=#D91414>3</color> times. When Extreme Dodge is triggered by pressing Dodge, gains <color=#D91414>30</color> Load Points instead of entering Matrix. When Dodge Gauge is empty, she can consume <color=#D91414>10</color> Load Points to perform a Dodge.

descriptions.title: Reflection Chain: <color=#0d70bc>During Kinetic Load enhanced by Cluster Orbs + Press and hold/Tap Basic Attack</color>
descriptions.description: Dashes toward the target and delivers a slashing attack, dealing Dark DMG while restoring <color=#D91414>80</color> Signature Energy.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>1852.94%</color> Dark DMG in total.

descriptions.title: Flaming Gush: <color=#0d70bc>During Kindled Blaze enhanced by Cluster Orbs + Press and hold/Tap Basic Attack</color>
descriptions.description: Leaps down from above to slash the target, converting Combustible into Ignition of equal stacks, dealing Ignition DMG and restoring <color=#D91414>80</color> Signature Energy.\n- Deals <color=#D91414>2573.53%</color> Ignition DMG in total. Jetavie gains <color=#D91414>Coreflame Mark</color> for <color=#D91414>10</color>s. Duration resets every time it is triggered.

descriptions.title: Forbidden Borders: <color=#0d70bc>Charge Stance + Release + Successful Dodge</color>
descriptions.description: While in Charge Stance, Jetavie can dodge attacks upon release. A successful dodge increases Extra DMG Bonus of the Charged Skill by <color=#D91414>30%</color>. During <color=#D91414>Kinetic Load</color> or <color=#D91414>Kindled Blaze</color>, a successful dodge additionally returns <color=#D91414>2</color> Cluster Orbs.

descriptions.title: Sector Reconfiguration
descriptions.description: While in Charge Stance, consumes <color=#D91414>250</color> Dodge Gauge to block each incoming attack. If Dodge Gauge is insufficient, consumes <color=#D91414>10 Load Points</color> per block instead.

descriptions.title: Overflux Surge: <color=#0d70bc>During sword attacks + Tap Basic Attack repetitively</color>
descriptions.description: Wields the greatsword to continuously attack the target, dealing Dark DMG.\n- Basic Attack deals a total of <color=#D91414>452.94%</color> Dark DMG.

descriptions.title: Diffusive Function: <color=#0d70bc>During sword attacks + Dodge + Tap/Press and hold Basic Attack</color>
descriptions.description: During sword attacks, quickly transitions into casting <color=#D91414>Crystalline Impact</color> on the target, dealing Ignition DMG and applying Combustible Charges.\n- By tapping Dodge, deals <color=#D91414>308.82%</color> Ignition DMG and applies <color=#D91414>1250</color> Combustible Charges in total.\n- After pressing and holding Dodge, releases to deal <color=#D91414>617.65%</color> Ignition DMG and applies <color=#D91414>2500</color> Combustible Charges in total.

descriptions.title: Metamorphic Encoding: <color=#0d70bc>During sword attacks + Press and hold Basic Attack to charge</color>
descriptions.description: During sword attacks, quickly transitions into casting <color=#D91414>Kinetic Load/Kindled Blaze</color> on the target, dealing damage. <color=#D91414>Kinetic Load/Kindled Blaze</color> cast this way cannot be followed up with other attacks.\n- Charges partially to cast <color=#D91414>Kindled Blaze</color>, dealing <color=#D91414>257.35%</color> Ignition DMG in total.\n- Charges fully to cast <color=#D91414>Kinetic Load</color>, dealing <color=#D91414>257.35%</color> Dark DMG in total.

descriptions.title: Effect: Ignition
descriptions.description: Combustible: Every <color=#D91414>250</color> Combustible Charges will add <color=#D91414>1</color> Combustible stack, up to 20 stacks.\nIgnition: Ignited units take Ignition DMG equal to <color=#D91414>Ignition stacks x30%</color> (Tank Skills will not be triggered) every second for 10s.\n- Upon the death of the last unit on the battlefield, subsequent units will inherit its Combustible/Ignition status.
Increases Dark DMG of all members by 10%.
Extra DMG Bonus increases by <color=#D91414>20.59%</color>.

descriptions.title: Gains 3 Signal Orbs when entering battle.
descriptions.description: Gains 3 Signal Orbs when entering battle.

descriptions.title: Lv.1: <color=#0d70bc>Unlocked at S5 Rank</color>
descriptions.description: Activates all available QTEs when casting <color=#D91414>Constant Current</color>.

descriptions.title: Lv.2: <color=#0d70bc>Unlocked at SS Rank</color>
descriptions.description: Gains <color=#D91414>70 Signature Energy</color> each time upon entering battle. Extra DMG Bonus increases by 30% during the <color=#D91414>Panoptic Segmentation</color> Mode. After entering <color=#D91414>Charge Stance</color> and having pinged all <color=#D91414>Cluster Orbs</color>, enhances Charged Skills 1 time for every <color=#D91414>10 Load Points</color> spent.

descriptions.title: Lv.1: <color=#0d70bc>Unlocked at SS3 Rank</color>
descriptions.description: Charged Skill Base DMG of Signal Orbs increases by <color=#D91414>100%</color>. Upon a successful Extreme Dodge, gains <color=#D91414>30 Load Points</color>.

descriptions.title: Lv.2: <color=#0d70bc>Unlocked at SSS Rank</color>
descriptions.description: Every <color=#D91414>Cluster Orb</color> pinged or <color=#D91414>10 Load Points</color> spent increases the Base DMG of <color=#D91414>Reflection Chain</color> and <color=#D91414>Flaming Gush</color> by <color=#D91414>25%</color>, up to <color=#D91414>75%</color>.

descriptions.title: Lv.1: <color=#0d70bc>Unlocked at SSS3 Rank</color>
descriptions.description: Extra DMG Bonus of <color=#D91414>Constant Current</color> increases by <color=#D91414>100%</color>.

descriptions.title: Lv.2: <color=#0d70bc>Unlocked at SSS6 Rank</color>
descriptions.description: Extra DMG Bonus of <color=#D91414>Kinetic Load</color> and <color=#D91414>Kindled Blaze</color> increases by <color=#D91414>70%</color>.

descriptions.title: Lv.3: <color=#0d70bc>Unlocked at SSS+ Rank</color>
descriptions.description: Extra DMG Bonus of <color=#D91414>Tectonic Revolt</color> increases by <color=#D91414>40%</color>.
